steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Nnnng...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I'm sorry.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Now, me beating on you doesn't mean we aren't on the same side.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Haha! Yeah, no, seriously. It does. We're not on the same side.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: This is Blaze. Come in, Team Blaze-4. Captured a dozen or so Reunion.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Come recover them when you can. Otherwise just hand them over to Lungmen.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Hey, Lungmenite, do me a favor and lower your crossbows. We're all friends here.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: You still don't trust me? I saved your life.

steps.name: L. G. D. Officer
steps.text: Get back...! I mean, y- you're... you're Infected...!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Yeah. Yeah I am.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Ugh.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Come on, Doctor.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Move!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Sigh. All right, Dr. {@nickname}. Hop on. It's faster this way.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Hah. You've gotten used to my piggyback rides?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Don't look at me like that. How many times have we been treated like this? It's no big deal.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Let's head to Waang Saan Plaza in District 16. If Reunion wants to break through the line, that's where they'll have to do it.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: If we're going to wipe out Reunion's main force, we can't let any of them slip through our zone of control.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: The way Amiya and the cranky old cop lady worked it out, we'll just be whittling them away little by little until we can finally wipe them all out in one swift stroke.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: So we go chase the bad guys out of Waang Saan Tower, herd them into a pincer attack, then meet up with Amiya and crush Reunion once and for all. Piece of cake, right?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: ...You and your faces. I told you I'm fine.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Fine. If you keep staring at me like that, I'm pulling this cat over.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Hold on tight.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Huh... Look over there.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Isn't that Mephisto's herd? But how. They need Mephisto around, don't they?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Wait a minute. They're... they're killing their own?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: ...What's going on?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I'm getting vitals, but no reports? And no sign of any distress signals either.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Something's not right...

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Shouldn't you be, like, commanding? What are you standing here staring at?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: None of your business, 'Little Miss.'

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Hey, shouldn't we be sharing intel?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Not this time.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: I'm thinking you lost contact with a spy.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Could you not waste your intuition on stuff like this?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: At least you own up to it when I guess right. Infected?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Yep.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: You think he turned?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Impossible.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: You think the impossible happened?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: If she turned... Well, I don't even want to think about it.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: If she betrayed us, then there's absolutely no one left in Lungmen we can trust.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: I think I know who it is.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Wait... Would she really be willing to do this?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Her? Really?!
